key_highlights: RBA rate hike exacerbates mortgage stress and triggers sharp deterioration in auction markets.
Surging government debt dampens prospects for immediate cost-of-living relief.
Escalating Middle East conflicts support domestic energy producers.
Robust exploration results drive momentum in junior gold, copper, and rare earth miners.
Unemployment poised to climb, increasing economic pressure on the consumer sector.

sectors.trend: Bearish due to mortgage stress and rising unemployment
sectors.implications: Increased risk of negative equity and higher bad debt provisions will weigh heavily on major banks.
Forecasted house price falls and smashed auction clearance rates present severe headwinds for property developers and REITs.
Escalation in the Middle East provides a premium for Australian gas exports and oil producers as a geopolitical hedge.

sectors.trend: Positive for gold and base metals
sectors.implications: Strong exploratory results in gold, copper, and critical minerals provide selective growth opportunities despite macroeconomic headwinds.
Public backlash against data centres and ATO scrutiny over zero income tax payments may cap sector upside and increase compliance costs.

key_themes: Monetary tightening and resulting housing/mortgage stress
Geopolitical escalation boosting defensive and energy assets
Junior resources outperformance in critical minerals and gold
Regulatory and community pushback on technology infrastructure

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential REITs and heavily exposed retail banks; diversify into defensive sectors.
Reduce exposure to consumer discretionary stocks; focus on consumer staples.
Increase exposure to USD-earning equities, particularly unhedged international earners and global miners.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Energy and Defensive Resource Stocks
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are providing a premium for Australian gas and oil, while gold remains a haven asset.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to Financials and Consumer Discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: The recent RBA hike is exacerbating mortgage stress, leading to negative equity risks and suppressing broader consumer spending as unemployment rises.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias for the broader ASX 200 (^AXJO) as the reality of the latest RBA rate hike prices into the domestic economy, particularly impacting property and retail. Energy and gold will likely outperform as geopolitical hedges.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious. The eventual peak in unemployment and stabilization of the housing market will be required before a sustained recovery. The 'Boomer exit' and energy transition remain dominant structural themes.
key_catalysts: Subsequent RBA rate decisions and commentary
Monthly CPI and employment data releases
Geopolitical developments in the Middle East
Auction clearance rates and residential property indices
watch_list: Bank bad debt provisions (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX)
Iron ore and gold spot prices
